subject: Welcome to Redwood — schedule a short walkthrough

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — schedule a short walkthrough

Hi Sophie —

Thanks for signing up for Redwood! I'm Naomi on the growth team — wanted to send a quick note and a link to schedule a short (30 min) technical walkthrough so we can tailor the trial to FinBridge's use case.

What we'll cover (30 min):
- Quick intro to Redwood's hosted inference and Dedicated options
- How to wire up your trial account and run a smoke test
- Performance/cost controls and recommended settings for small-batch inference

Pick a time that works for you: https://cal.redwood.com/naomi-30
(If you'd rather, reply with 2–3 windows in CEST and Ben (cc'd) will coordinate.)

I've attached a one-page Quickstart PDF that summarizes the steps you'll see in the trial.

Thanks — talk soon,

Naomi Feldman
Growth Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Attach: trial-quickstart.pdf (application/pdf, 220KB)
